headers.//: Reels and their posters are content-addressed by name and never edited in place: a new cut gets a new render, not a new byte in the same file. A year is safe and it is the difference between a repeat visitor streaming 7MB again or nothing at all.
Next fingerprints everything under _next/static with a content hash, so the same URL can never mean two different files.
The book is one 4.5MB file rebuilt whenever a chapter changes, so it revalidates rather than caching hard. must-revalidate keeps a stale copy from being served after an edit.
